I’m 41 now and have seen many changes over the years.

To be completely honest, I was quite shocked when I saw the rating overall and wanted to share a little of my experience here.

There are many fantastic people working here in various capacities. The general manager, currently enjoying her newborn Emma is the most personable, understanding manager there ever has been in my experience. Incredibly helpful, does what she says she will do and I’ve seen first hand the efficiency Emma Barnes (married now and the name escapes me i apologise)

There is a lovely lady on reception called Mia who has a lovely manner  on the phone and in person. This lady also gets things done in the event of a time dependent task, keeping you up to speed all the way. Linda, also an efficient, and helpful voice on reception. I say reception but there are so many other tasks they’re literally inundated with. So I don’t really think it’s a fair assumption that any of these ladies are in any way inefficient. There are a couple of other ladies but regretfully their names elude me.

I said I would be honest and anything but, simply goes against my ethics. So unfortunately very recently, I have had conversations with two identifiable ladies at reception whom are relatively new but that’s no excuse. The way I myself have been spoken to by them is unacceptable and working with people, some whom are very poorly or have complex medical needs don’t deserve to be spoken to down the phone condescendingly, short and quite frankly these things do tarnish the reputation of the surgery as the reception team are the face of the medical centre. The first people patients are greeted with are the ladies on reception. That’s all I will say on this matter about this. Because even though it is disappointing when spoken to in a derogatory manner, we have to remember just how understaffed, overworked and with limited time in which to complete their massive workload every day.

The reception team does far more than answering phones, there’s so much behind the scenes of their administrative positions and we would do well to remind ourselves that they are human beings too.

The Doctors surgery has been forced to take on patients where there are already struggles in the ratio of patients to Doctors which then transcends through the system and onto the desks of the reception staff.

Lastly but certainly not least, I would like to give my utmost thanks, respect and gratitude to a Doctor who has been absolutely fantastic in helping me on my lifelong journey living with chronic illnesses. This is the only Doctor I will see and I wish there was something more that could be done on my part to express just how much this amazing Doctor has been proactive in assisting with my recovery and ongoing journey with mental illness.

In conclusion, I’d like to extend my appreciation and thanks to all of you. All working here are an integral, valuable part of the proverbial body in our collective General Practitioners and surgeries,   so on behalf of myself and I’m sure others would agree, your services are vital in keeping us all in good health. You all work in an enormously pressure based area of medical care, to say I’m appreciative doesn’t quite cut it. However, words are all I have so I hope this will work its way to all and again I thank you for the critical services you provide us with.

D.Shaw",null,[0,99]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURBd191MzVRRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xb3886e55e801a28!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgMDAw_u35QE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURBd191MzVRRRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURBd191MzVRRRItChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURBd191M0ZREhNDZ3dJcDVLdHZRWVEwS09oeXdNGi4KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdNREF3X3UzbFFFEhNDZ3dJcDVLdHZRWVEwS09oeXdNIhIJAAAAAAAAAAARKBqAXuWGOAsqE0Nnd0lwNUt0dlFZUTBLT2h5d00&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwj9tIz8oa6TAxXMI2MBHXZQD_oQoykIBygB"],null,[null,[[1,1]]]],"0ahUKEwj9tIz8oa6TAxXMI2MBHXZQD_oQ0pMFCAUoAQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFEQnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUl6UkZwZlgxOWZSV2hDZWxsME9XdENkV1ozVjFkcFNGaGpTVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpvU1VOaGQzSnhUeTFSV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25OamRIVnVaWEZWVW05a01scFJlRmxXYVdaMlJtYxAB",["0x0:0xb3886e55e801a28",null,1750676949365491,1750676949365491,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/114601966897026563343/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Jean Lewis","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUxAT_WWUnMZegP4EOYJA-ekMoIEPdwy7Xn_-lcQalBEWr_JP_q=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/114601966897026563343?hl=en"],"114601966897026563343",null,3,0,null,[0,2,1],0,["3 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwj9tIz8oa6TAxXMI2MBHXZQD_oQ7LoGCAkoAA"]]]],null,"8 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Phoned today to book an appointment and the young lady I spoke to was really helpful. I have called two days running at 8am on the dot only to be in a lengthy queue (25th today). When you eventually get through you are told there are no appointments left - not even telephone appointments and you have to do the same again tomorrow.
I struggle to phone at 8am as I work with animals and its my busiest time of the day - but they don’t consider that and it’s 8am or nothing!
I asked about pre-bookable appointments and there’s nothing for 5-6 WEEKS!
The service and attitude of the office staff has got progressively worse since Lockdown with many lacking any empathy or customer care skills. They prefer not to speak to you refer you to use their online ‘Ask my GP’ service which is never working and when I got a fault on it I was told it was nothing to so with them - and it was basically ‘hard luck’.

A female family member needed to be seen as an emergency (post-menopausal bleeding) only to be told to make a routine appointment - she made a complaint as that symptom is a medical emergency and I believe the staff had training following that - but it didn’t change the unnecessary stress caused from the receptionist's lack of care and knowledge which they should have in a ‘first contact’ role!

The attitude of the receptionists is disgusting. On a past visit to the surgery I was sat in the waiting area and a patient came in with a sample - but the receptionist was rude to him saying he was to late - he worked away so had no other option. She was discussing his personal details at the reception for everyone to hear - what happened to patient CONFIDENTIALITY!
He left and she went into the office calling him behind his back - which could be heard from the waiting area! I was horrified. When the receptionist came back into the waiting area I certainly let her know what I’d heard her say - but she just shrugged it off.
I complained about this to the Physiotherapist and the Reception Manager at the time.
I was once a doctors receptionist myself and I’d never speak to patients (or another person) the way they do.

Doctors Effingham, Dr Mosely, Dr Barnes, Dr Jana & Dr Strattford -Smith are lovely and I’ll miss them - I’m sure they would be devastated to learn how the receptionists treat and talk to their vulnerable patients!

On the plus side - Linda did recognise our elderly mums voice once on the phone and instantly knew that something was drastically wrong.
